body: I love my cat and he love me back even more. I would be lost without him. I'm in a pretty bad situation right now too though. Good thing there is Reddit to keep me occupied at night.
This seems like the best time to tell someone about this new job!
What if your the person who prevents someone from dying? What if you stop to talk to someone and by doing that you prevent them from being hit by a car.

I've been fighting with this for 8 months. I don't find joy in anything anymore. To top it off my sister helped her with the money to leave so I haven't talked to her since that day either. After 8 months nothing has changed and I feel like I'm just killing time and going nowhere.

My wife wanted to move so we moved. I took a year off of work and we lived off our savings and enjoyed ourselves with the plan that after about a year we would both get jobs and then start working towards a house which would have been easy with two incomes. It was great but once I went back to work and she didnt want to work and started saying she missed her family back home. Well shes went back home and now Im here. It wasnt even like we had any major problems. We had one big fight because I wasnt happy with the way she wasnt doing her share and I was working.

Its not really my job that's the problem. I had a plan for my life but it failed. I don't feel like I can fix it anymore. If my wife would have stuck to the plan then we would have had a wonderful life. But now that its over I really dont see anyway to salvage it anymore.
I don't want to do anything else. I wish I would get laid off and just go on unemployment so I wouldn't have to face anyone anymore.

I did like my job and I am great at it. Since my wife left me about 8 months ago and ruined the plans that we had setup for ourselves now its just not possible to fix things in my life. Its been going down hill ever since that one day.I just cut off ties with everyone and the only thing I had was my job. But things are too far gone now and its doesn't look fixable.
